# Raw strings. TOKENS (resolved per language by the Control Plane with the same table as the Site, src/i18n/eaTokens.ts): {until} = the trial END day, short, with the year (Dec 31, 2026); {lastDay} = the trial END day, long (December 31, 2026);
#   {regShort} = the REGISTRATION close day, short (Dec 24, 2026); {regDate} = the same day, long (December 24, 2026); {regLast} = the last day a trial can be started, long, UTC (December 23, 2026); {n} = the paid store count of the plan (1 / 3 / 10 from plans.ts).
# Clocks: registration closes 2026-12-24T00:00:00Z (CP AICC_LM_Trial::REGISTRATION_CUTOFF_UNIX 1798070400; accepted while the server clock is BEFORE it); trial access ends 2026-12-31T22:00:00Z (CUTOFF_UNIX 1798754400). Both are written in UTC only.
# The two dates are ALWAYS two separate labelled lines: ss.plan.regLabel + ss.plan.regValue, ss.plan.endLabel + ss.plan.endValue (cards, bands, finder) and the long forms ss.terms.regValue / ss.terms.endValue (terms block). he times carry U+2066 ... U+2069 (a left-to-right isolate around 00:00 UTC / 22:00 UTC) and a no-break space before it; keep them.
